intro: Sunday: Google I/O week begins tomorrow — and today the leaks are flying. A landmark AI governance agreement between the US and UK, OpenAI's custom model programme quietly expands, and Anthropic launches a new safety evaluation framework. The week ahead will reshape the AI landscape.

top_stories.headline: US-UK AI Safety Partnership Signs Binding Testing Agreement for Frontier Models
top_stories.summary: The US and UK AI Safety Institutes signed a formal bilateral agreement requiring coordinated safety testing before any frontier AI model releases above a defined capability threshold. The agreement establishes shared red-teaming methodologies, incident reporting protocols, and a 90-day pre-release evaluation window for qualifying models. Canada and Australia are expected to sign within 30 days.

top_stories.headline: Google I/O 2026 Preview: Gemini Ultra 2 and Project Astra Multimodal Agent Expected
top_stories.summary: Bloomberg and The Verge both report that tomorrow's Google I/O keynote will feature Gemini Ultra 2 with native real-time video understanding and Project Astra's consumer launch — a multimodal AI agent that can see through your phone camera, answer questions about your environment, and remember past conversations across sessions.

top_stories.headline: OpenAI Custom Model Programme Expands to 50 Enterprise Clients with Fine-Tuning Access
top_stories.summary: OpenAI quietly expanded its Custom Model Programme — which provides direct fine-tuning access to GPT-5 on proprietary data — from 12 to 50 enterprise clients. Clients include financial services firms, healthcare systems, and legal platforms. Pricing is reported at $2-5M annually, with models trained on client data retained exclusively for that client.

top_stories.headline: Anthropic Publishes CLIO: A Real-Time AI Behaviour Monitoring Framework for Production Models
top_stories.summary: Anthropic released CLIO (Claude's Long-term Impact Observatory), an open-source framework for monitoring AI model behaviour in production across safety dimensions — jailbreaks, prompt injections, output quality drift, and policy violations. CLIO logs 40+ behavioural metrics in real time and generates weekly safety reports. It is now integrated into Claude's API as an opt-in monitoring layer.

top_stories.headline: Inflection AI Returns with Pi 3 — Focuses on Long-Term Emotional Intelligence
top_stories.summary: Inflection AI, reconstituted after Microsoft hired its founding team, has released Pi 3 under new leadership. Pi 3 positions itself as the 'emotionally intelligent' AI with a focus on long-term relationship and wellbeing support — rather than task completion. It features persistent memory across conversations, empathetic framing, and referrals to professional support for mental health topics.

quick_hits.text: Google Workspace AI features including Duet AI and Gmail smart compose are now included in all Google Workspace plans at no additional cost, removing the $30/month AI add-on.
Perplexity AI passed 100 million monthly active users — the fastest AI product to reach this milestone outside of ChatGPT.
OpenAI released a new system prompt library with 200 tested templates for enterprise use cases, available via the developer platform.
Cohere released its Command R+ model under an Apache 2.0 licence for organisations with under $10M annual revenue — its largest open-source release.
Salesforce Einstein AI surpassed 1 trillion autonomous actions per month across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud customers.

tools_products.name: CLIO (Claude's Long-term Impact Observatory)
tools_products.what: Open-source production AI monitoring framework with 40+ behavioural metrics, integrated into Claude API as an opt-in safety layer.

tools_products.name: Pi 3
tools_products.what: Emotionally intelligent AI assistant with persistent cross-session memory, empathetic framing, and professional support referrals for mental health topics.

tools_products.name: Google Workspace AI (Included)
tools_products.what: Duet AI, Gmail smart compose, Docs AI, and Meet summaries now included in all Workspace plans — previously a $30/month add-on.

tools_products.name: OpenAI System Prompt Library
tools_products.what: 200 tested system prompt templates for enterprise use cases including customer support, legal review, financial analysis, and HR workflows.

tools_products.name: Command R+ Apache 2.0
tools_products.what: Command R+ released under Apache 2.0 for organisations under $10M ARR — the most capable open-source RAG model available for self-hosted enterprise deployment.

india_roundup.text: Paytm announced an AI-powered credit score engine for gig workers, using alternative data (ride history, UPI transactions, app usage patterns) to underwrite credit for the 100M+ informal sector workers excluded from traditional scoring.
NITI Aayog released a 150-page AI readiness framework for Indian government departments, with a tiered implementation roadmap from basic automation to predictive governance by 2030.
Ather Energy, India's EV maker, deployed an AI predictive maintenance system that analyses telemetry from 300,000 scooters in real time, reducing service downtime by 28%.
IIT Madras researchers published a breakthrough in AI-assisted detection of diabetic retinopathy, achieving 94.7% accuracy on a dataset of 500,000 retinal scans from South Indian patients.
Zepto, India's quick commerce platform, uses an AI demand-prediction model to optimise dark store inventory across 350 cities, reducing food waste by 22% and stockouts by 17%.

closing_insight: The US-UK AI safety agreement is the first binding international AI governance framework — not a declaration, not a communiqué, but a signed testing protocol. Every major AI development since 2022 has been faster than predicted. Safety governance will not be.
